metadata.name: sheetView
metadata.description: (cfg editing draft mount error keys vals srcs geom selected selectedSrc) - spreadsheet RenderSpec producer: each worksheet table wrapped in a draggable window frame. Single-click SELECTS a cell (origin.select sets 元.selected) and the cell KEEPS rendering its value; the window's formula bar shows the SELECTED cell's source (bound to 元.draft) and commits on Enter (origin.key) to 元.selected. Double-click opens the inline editor. Formula bar order is left-to-right [W wiki][gun fire][textarea]: the gun is an inline SVG pistol (origin.fire — re-evaluate the selected cell), the W opens the wiki. The bar textarea defaults to a tall multi-line box (min-height ~7.5rem) and wraps (pre-wrap, no horizontal scrollbar); resize:vertical lets the user grow it further. Tabs render by win.geom[seg].order; dragging a tab chip reorders it among siblings (winsheet.tabMove) or, released off the window, tears it into its own window (winsheet.tabDrop -> tearoff). Dragging a window/tab over another window glows the target (win.geom[seg].glow) to show where it will land. Cells render clean (no per-cell glyphs). The titlebar shows exactly one of ◱ (mid/restore, when maximized) and ⛶ (maximize, when not), plus – minimize and ✕ close.

metadata.name: winsheet.move

metadata.name: winsheet.raise

metadata.name: winsheet.minimize

metadata.name: winsheet.close

metadata.name: winsheet.restore
metadata.description: restore

metadata.name: winsheet.stop
metadata.description: stop button press starting a drag

metadata.name: winsheet.maximize
metadata.description: (state, seg) - maximize a worksheet window to the viewport and set win.geom[seg].max=1 so the titlebar swaps ⛶ for ◱ (mid/restore).

metadata.name: winsheet.mid
metadata.description: (state, seg) - reset a worksheet window to a mid size and clear win.geom[seg].max so the titlebar shows ⛶ (maximize) again.

metadata.name: winsheet.tab
metadata.description: switch the active tab of a host window

metadata.name: winsheet.tearoff
metadata.description: (state, seg) - tear a tab out of its host into a standalone window: clear win.geom[seg].host and offset its position. Reached by double-clicking a tab OR by dragging a tab OUT of its window (winsheet.tabDrop).

metadata.name: winsheet.tabdrag
metadata.description: in-progress tab drag { host, tab } (null when idle); set on a tab chip's pointerdown, drives reorder/tear-off, cleared on pointerup.

metadata.name: winsheet.tabGrab
metadata.description: (state, { host, tab }, event) - pointerdown on a tab chip: capture the pointer and record winsheet.tabdrag so a drag can reorder the tab or tear it off (a plain click still selects the tab).

metadata.name: winsheet.tabMove
metadata.description: (state, payload, event) - while a tab is dragging, if the pointer is over a SIBLING tab chip, rewrite win.geom[seg].order for the clique so the dragged tab takes the hovered slot — the tab strip re-renders in the new order.

metadata.name: winsheet.tabDrop
metadata.description: (state, payload, event) - pointerup ending a tab drag: if released OFF the host window it TEARS the tab off (winsheet.tearoff); otherwise it keeps the reordered order and activates the tab. Clears winsheet.tabdrag.

metadata.name: winsheet.newtab
metadata.description: (state, host) - the '+' on a worksheet window's tab strip: genesis-create a BLANK 10x10 sheet, mint it as its own private closure, tab it into the clicked window (win.geom[new].host=host), and bundle the host clique so the new tab shares memory with its host.

metadata.name: winsheet.syncBundles
metadata.description: (state) - make SEEDED tab relationships grant shared memory like a runtime drop does: scan win.geom and bundleSegments each {host, tabs...} clique, so a sheet minted private-get (a closure) can read its host's cels when win.geom seeds seg.host (e.g. turtlecharts tabbed into turtles reads turtles!). Idempotent; the host calls it after the desktop genesis materializes.
